# Privacy Notice – Pathshala Plus

**About Us**  
Pathshala Plus is located in Jaipur, India (Website: https://pathshalaplus.in). We offer a maths and science learning app for students in classes 6 to 10, featuring live doubt-solving classes and weekly tests. Our users include individuals under 18 years of age.

**Personal Data We Collect**  
When you sign up and use Pathshala Plus, we collect the following personal data:
* Student's name
* Class and school name
* Parent's mobile number
* Parent's email address
* Test scores and progress reports
* Recordings of live doubt-solving sessions

**Purposes of Processing**  
We collect and use this data for the following purposes:
* To create the student's account and personalise lessons to their class
* To send progress reports and class reminders to the parent
* To record live sessions so the student can rewatch them

**Managing Your Data and Getting Help**  
* You can manage your settings in the app or on the website under **Settings**.  
* You can get support and assistance under **Help**.

**Privacy Contact and Complaints**  
If you have questions or wish to file a complaint regarding your privacy, please contact:  
* **Data Protection Officer:** Ritu Sharma  
* **Email:** dpo@pathshalaplus.in  

We reply to complaints within 30 days.

# PRIVACY NOTICE AND CONSENT FORM

**Pathshala Plus**  
**Website:** https://pathshalaplus.in  
**Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan, India  

---

### **1. Introduction and Scope**
This Privacy Notice is issued by Pathshala Plus in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025. 

Pathshala Plus provides maths and science learning services, live doubt-solving classes, and weekly performance tests for students in Classes 6 to 10. Because our students are under 18 years of age (minors), this notice is directed to the parent or lawful guardian. Consent must be provided by the parent/lawful guardian to allow account creation and service delivery for the student.

---

### **2. Personal Data Collected and Specific Purposes**

We collect only the personal data necessary to deliver our educational services. Below is the itemised breakdown of personal data collected and the specific purpose for each:

| Personal Data Collected | Specific Purpose of Processing |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Student's Name** | To create and identify the student’s profile on the platform. |
| **Class and School Name** | To personalize lessons, tests, and study material relevant to the student’s academic level and curriculum. |
| **Parent's Mobile Number** | To send class reminders, security notifications, account verification codes (OTPs), and operational updates. |
| **Parent's Email Address** | To deliver academic progress reports, weekly performance updates, and official communications. |
| **Test Scores & Progress Reports** | To track the student's learning progress, evaluate performance, and personalize educational feedback. |
| **Recordings of Live Doubt-Solving Sessions** | To allow the student to rewatch past live classes for revision and review. |

---

### **3. Protections for Minor Students**

In compliance with Section 9 of the DPDP Act, 2023:
* **No Behavioral Tracking:** We do not track or monitor the behavior of children, nor do we profile them for commercial purposes.
* **No Targeted Advertising:** We do not display targeted advertisements to students.
* **Parental Verification:** We collect and verify consent from the parent or lawful guardian prior to processing any personal data of the student.

---

### **4. Rights of the Data Principal (Parents & Guardians)**

Under the DPDP Act, parents and legal guardians (acting on behalf of themselves and their children) have the following rights:

1. **Right to Access Information:** Request a summary of the personal data being processed and the identities of any third parties with whom data has been shared.
2. **Right to Correction and Erasure:** Request the correction, completion, updating, or erasure of personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete, or no longer required for the purpose it was collected.
3. **Right to Withdraw Consent:** You may withdraw your consent at any time. Upon withdrawal, we will cease processing your personal data, which may result in the termination of access to Pathshala Plus services.
4. **Right of Grievance Redressal:** You have the right to seek redressal for any grievances regarding the processing of your personal data.
5. **Right to Nominate:** You have the right to nominate another individual to exercise your data rights in the event of death or incapacity.

---

### **5. Managing Your Data and Settings**

You can view, update, or correct your profile details and manage data preferences at any time:
* **In-App / Website:** Log in to your account and navigate to **Settings** to update your account information, or visit the **Help** section to submit specific data requests.

---

### **6. Grievance Redressal and Data Protection Officer**

If you have any questions, concerns, requests, or complaints regarding your personal data or this notice, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

* **Data Protection Officer:** Ritu Sharma  
* **Email Address:** dpo@pathshalaplus.in  
* **Address:** Pathshala Plus, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India  

**Resolution Timeline:** We will acknowledge your grievance and respond to or resolve your complaint within **30 calendar days** of receipt.

---

### **7. Right to Lodge a Complaint with the Data Protection Board**

If you are not satisfied with the resolution provided by our Data Protection Officer, or if we fail to respond within 30 days, you have the legal right to register a complaint with the **Data Protection Board of India (DPBI)** in the manner prescribed under the DPDP Act and Rules.

---

### **8. Language and Availability**

This notice is available in English. If you require this notice in any of the 22 languages specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India, please submit a request to dpo@pathshalaplus.in.

---

### **CONSENT DECLARATION**

By clicking **"I Agree"** or checking the consent box during signup:
1. You confirm that you are the parent or legal guardian of the student being enrolled.
2. You acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Notice.
3. You give free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous consent to Pathshala Plus to collect and process your personal data and your child's personal data for the specific purposes outlined above.

# PRIVACY AND CONSENT NOTICE

**SehatSaathi Clinic**  
Website: [https://sehatsaathi.in](https://sehatsaathi.in)  
Effective Date: March 2025  

This Privacy Notice is issued by **SehatSaathi Clinic**, Pune, India ("we", "us", or "our") in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025. 

Before signing up and using our services, please read this notice carefully. By clicking **"I Agree"** or checking the consent box during registration, you provide your free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous consent for us to process your personal data for the specific purposes set out below.

---

### 1. Personal Data We Collect
When you register for an account, book an appointment, or consult with our doctors through our website or mobile application, we collect the following personal data:

* **Basic Identity & Contact Information:** Name, age, gender, and mobile number.
* **Health & Medical Information:** Symptoms, medical history, clinical notes, prescriptions, and diagnostic/lab reports.
* **Financial Details:** Payment details necessary to process consultation fees.

---

### 2. Purposes for Processing Your Personal Data
We process your personal data solely for the following specified, lawful purposes:

1. **Appointment Management:** To schedule, confirm, modify, and manage your online and in-person clinic appointments.
2. **Medical Consultation & Care:** To enable healthcare professionals at SehatSaathi Clinic to provide teleconsultations, diagnose health conditions, and maintain accurate treatment records.
3. **Medical Records Sharing:** To generate, store, and securely share prescriptions and lab reports directly with you.
4. **Payment Processing:** To collect fees for consultations and related healthcare services.

We will not process your personal data for any purpose other than those stated above without obtaining your prior explicit consent.

---

### 3. Age Restriction (Users Under 18)
Our online registration and direct services are intended strictly for individuals who are **18 years of age or older**. By signing up, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old. We do not knowingly permit individuals under 18 to create an account independently.

---

### 4. Your Rights as a Data Principal
Under the DPDP Act, 2023, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

* **Right to Access Information:** You have the right to obtain a summary of the personal data we process about you and the identities of any third parties with whom it has been shared.
* **Right to Correction and Erasure:** You have the right to request the correction, completion, updating, or erasure of your personal data that is no longer necessary for the specified purposes, unless retention is required by law.
* **Right to Withdraw Consent:** You may withdraw your consent at any time. The withdrawal of consent will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
* **Right of Grievance Redressal:** You have the right to have your complaints addressed regarding the processing of your personal data.
* **Right to Nominate:** You have the right to nominate another individual to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.

---

### 5. How to Exercise Your Rights & Manage Consent
You can easily manage your data preferences and exercise your rights through the following channels:

* **In-App / Website Controls:** Go to **Settings** in your SehatSaathi account to update your contact details or manage consent preferences.
* **Customer Support:** Access the **Help** section on our website or mobile app for guidance on data requests.
* **Consent Withdrawal & Erasure Requests:** You may request to withdraw your consent or delete your account at any time via the **Settings** menu or by emailing our Data Protection Officer.

---

### 6. Grievance Redressal & Contact Details
If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding the processing of your personal data or wish to exercise your rights, please contact our designated Data Protection Officer (DPO):

* **Data Protection Officer:** Dr. Meera Kulkarni  
* **Designation:** Data Protection Officer, SehatSaathi Clinic  
* **Email Address:** privacy@sehatsaathi.in  
* **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra, India  

We are committed to resolving all grievances promptly. We will acknowledge and respond to your complaint or request within **30 days** of receipt.

---

### 7. Right to Complain to the Data Protection Board of India
If you are unsatisfied with our response to your grievance, or if you believe your personal data rights under the DPDP Act have been violated, you have the right to file a complaint directly with the **Data Protection Board of India (DPBI)** through its official portal.

---

### Consent Declaration
By checking the box or clicking **"I Agree"**, you confirm that:
1. You are 18 years of age or older.
2. You have read and understood this Privacy Notice.
3. You freely consent to the collection, storage, and processing of your personal data by SehatSaathi Clinic for the purposes described above.

# PRIVACY NOTICE

**Khelo Arena**  
**Effective Date:** Launch Date  
**Website:** [https://kheloarena.games](https://kheloarena.games)  
**Data Fiduciary:** Khelo Arena, Hyderabad, Telangana, India  

This Privacy Notice is provided in accordance with the **Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA)** and the **Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025**. It explains how Khelo Arena collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you create an account, play our games, or use our platform.

---

### 1. What Personal Data We Collect and Why

We collect only the personal data necessary to provide you with a fun, safe, and fair gaming experience. Below is the itemized list of data collected and the specific purpose for each item:

| Personal Data Collected | Purpose of Collection |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Username** | To set up and manage your player account, display your name on leaderboards, and identify you to friends in the game. |
| **Age** | To verify age eligibility, determine minor status (under 18 years), and initiate verifiable parental consent where required by law. |
| **Email Address** | To manage your account, support account recovery, contact parents/guardians for consent, and respond to support queries. |
| **Game Progress and Scores** | To save your gameplay status, record high scores, and feature your rankings on public in-game leaderboards. |
| **Device Identifier** | To secure the platform, prevent cheating or fraud, and ensure fair play for all users. |
| **Chat Messages** | To enable in-game messaging and communication with your friends on the platform. |

---

### 2. Notice for Users Under 18 Years and Parents/Guardians

Khelo Arena is designed for players of all ages, including children and teenagers (aged 10 to 17). 

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023:
* Any player under the age of 18 is classified as a child.
* **Parental/Guardian Consent:** We require verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian before creating an account or processing personal data for any user under 18 years of age.
* **Child Safety Protections:** Khelo Arena does **not** engage in targeted advertising, behavioral tracking, or monitoring of users under 18 years of age, nor do we process personal data in a manner likely to cause harm to a child.

---

### 3. Your Rights as a Data Principal

Under India's DPDP Act, 2023, you (or your parent/guardian, if you are under 18) have the following rights regarding your personal data:

1. **Right to Access & Information:** Request a summary of personal data being processed and the identities of any third parties with whom it has been shared.
2. **Right to Correction and Erasure:** Request the correction, updating, completion, or deletion of your personal data that is no longer necessary for the specified purposes.
3. **Right to Withdraw Consent:** You may withdraw your consent for data processing at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the legality of processing done prior to withdrawal. Please note that withdrawing consent may limit your access to certain game features (such as online chat or leaderboards).
4. **Right to Nominate:** You have the right to nominate another individual to exercise your data protection rights in the event of death or incapacity.
5. **Right to Grievance Redressal:** You have the right to readily available means of grievance redressal regarding your personal data.

---

### 4. How to Exercise Your Rights & Manage Your Data

* **In-App Controls:** You can review and update your profile information or adjust your privacy preferences at any time by navigating to **Settings** within the game app or on our website.
* **Help Desk:** For assistance with your account, data rights requests, or consent withdrawal, visit the **Help** section in the app or website.

---

### 5. Grievance Redressal & Contact Information

If you or your parent/guardian have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding the processing of your personal data or this Privacy Notice, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

* **Data Protection Officer:** Kavya Iyer  
* **Email:** [dpo@kheloarena.games](mailto:dpo@kheloarena.games)  
* **Location:** Khelo Arena, Hyderabad, Telangana, India  

We are committed to addressing and resolving your grievances promptly and will respond to all valid complaints within **30 days** of receipt.

---

### 6. Right to Lodge a Complaint with the Board

If you are unsatisfied with our response to your grievance or if you believe your personal data rights under the DPDPA, 2023 have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the **Data Protection Board of India (DPBI)** in the manner prescribed by the Board.

---

*By selecting "I Agree" or proceeding to create an account, you confirm that you have read this Privacy Notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data (or your child's personal data) for the purposes described above.*

# PRIVACY NOTICE

**SafarSathi**  
Kochi, Kerala, India  
Website: https://safarsathi.in  

*Notice issued pursuant to Section 5 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025.*

---

### 1. Introduction
This Privacy Notice explains how SafarSathi ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal data when you use our website (https://safarsathi.in) and mobile application to book intercity bus tickets across Kerala and Tamil Nadu. 

By signing up and providing your consent, you agree to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with this Notice and applicable laws.

---

### 2. Personal Data We Collect and Purposes of Processing

We collect only the personal data necessary to provide you with our ticket booking services. Below is an itemised summary of the data we collect and the specific purpose for each processing activity:

| Personal Data Category | Specific Purpose of Processing |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | To issue bus tickets, verify passenger identity, and share with bus operators for trip validation. |
| **Age and Gender** | To assign seating preferences (where applicable), ensure safety compliance, and share with bus operators as required for the trip. |
| **Mobile Number** | To issue tickets, send booking confirmations, send real-time trip updates (e.g., delay alerts, boarding point details), and manage user accounts. |
| **Email Address** | To send e-tickets, payment receipts, refund details, and essential service updates. |
| **Travel History and Bookings** | To manage active and past reservations, process ticket modifications or cancellations, and provide support. |
| **Payment Card or UPI Details** | To process ticket purchases securely and issue refunds for cancelled tickets. *(Note: Payment details are processed directly through PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways).* |

---

### 3. Data Sharing with Third Parties

To facilitate your travel, SafarSathi will share specific passenger details (**Name, Age, and Gender**) with the respective **bus operator** conducting the journey you book. Bus operators require this information for passenger manifest verification, security, and boarding control. 

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

---

### 4. Restriction on Minors (Users Under 18)

SafarSathi is intended exclusively for individuals who are **18 years of age or older**. We do not knowingly permit individuals under the age of 18 to create an account or book tickets through our platform. If we become aware that personal data of a person under 18 has been collected without lawful authorization, we will promptly erase such data.

---

### 5. Your Rights as a Data Principal

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

* **Right to Access:** You have the right to request a summary of the personal data we hold about you and the processing activities undertaken.
* **Right to Correction and Erasure:** You have the right to correct inaccurate or incomplete data, update your data, or request the erasure of your personal data that is no longer necessary for the specified purpose.
* **Right to Withdraw Consent:** You may withdraw your consent to data processing at any time. Withdrawal of consent will not affect the legality of processing done prior to such withdrawal. Please note that withdrawing consent may limit our ability to provide ticket booking services to you.
* **Right of Grievance Redressal:** You have the right to register a grievance with us regarding the processing of your personal data.
* **Right to Nominate:** You have the right to nominate an individual who shall, in the event of your death or incapacity, exercise your rights as a Data Principal under the law.

---

### 6. Managing Your Data and Options

You can manage your account details, preferences, and exercise your rights directly within our platform:
* **Account Controls:** Navigate to **Settings** in the SafarSathi app or website to view, edit, or update your personal information.
* **Support & Consent Withdrawal:** Navigate to the **Help** section in the app/website or contact our Data Protection Officer to request consent withdrawal, account deletion, or data erasure.

---

### 7. Grievance Redressal and Contact Information

If you have questions, concerns, or grievances regarding this Privacy Notice or the processing of your personal data, please contact our Data Protection Officer:

**Data Protection Officer (DPO):** Thomas Varghese  
**Entity:** SafarSathi, Kochi, India  
**Email:** dpo@safarsathi.in  

**Resolution Timeframe:** We acknowledge all grievances promptly and will address and resolve your complaints within **30 days** from the date of receipt.

If you are not satisfied with our response or the resolution of your grievance, you have the right to file a complaint with the **Data Protection Board of India**.

---

### 8. Language Availability

In accordance with Section 5(3) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, this Notice is available in English and can be accessed in any of the 22 languages specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India upon request via the app/website settings or by contacting our Data Protection Officer.

**PRIVACY NOTICE**

**Vidya Scholarship Portal** (https://vidyascholarship.org), managed by Vidya Trust, Bhopal, India, is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025. 

Because our scholarship applicants are school students aged 14 to 18 (minors), this Notice is addressed to both the student and their parent or lawful guardian. Personal data of students is collected and processed only with the verifiable consent of their parent or lawful guardian.

---

### 1. What Personal Data We Collect
We collect the following personal data during signup and scholarship application:
*   **Student Information:** Full name, date of birth, school name, and academic marksheets.
*   **Financial & Eligibility Information:** Family income certificate and bank account details.
*   **Parent/Guardian Information:** Parent’s/guardian's full name and mobile number.

---

### 2. Why We Collect Your Data (Purposes)
We process your personal data strictly for the following purposes:
*   **Assessing Applications:** To evaluate student eligibility and select merit scholarship recipients using academic records and income certificates.
*   **Disbursing Scholarships:** To transfer scholarship funds directly into the provided bank account.
*   **Parent Communication & Verification:** To verify parental consent and contact parents/guardians with updates regarding the application and payments.

---

### 3. Parental Consent for Minors
If you are under 18 years of age, your parent or legal guardian must review this notice and provide consent on your behalf before you can register or submit an application on the portal.

---

### 4. Your Rights as Data Principals / Parents
Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, parents/guardians and students have the following rights:
*   **Right to Access:** View a summary of the personal data being processed and the processing activities.
*   **Right to Correction and Erasure:** Request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data, or the deletion of data once it is no longer necessary for the scholarship process.
*   **Right to Withdraw Consent:** You may withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawing consent will stop further processing of data, though it may affect scholarship eligibility or payment processing.
*   **Right to Grievance Redressal:** You have the right to register complaints regarding the processing of your data.

---

### 5. Managing Your Settings and Seeking Help
*   **Account Settings:** You can review, update, or edit your information and manage your consent choices on our website by navigating to **Settings**.
*   **Help & Support:** For general assistance with your application or profile, please visit our **Help** section on the website.

---

### 6. Grievance Redressal & Contact Information
If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding your personal data or wish to exercise your legal rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer:

*   **Data Protection Officer:** Sister Mary Joseph
*   **Email:** dpo@vidyascholarship.org
*   **Address:** Vidya Scholarship Portal, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India
*   **Website:** https://vidyascholarship.org

We will acknowledge and resolve all privacy-related complaints within **30 days** of receiving them.

If you are not satisfied with our response or the resolution of your grievance, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the **Data Protection Board of India**.

---

### 7. Consent Declaration
By ticking the consent box during registration, the parent/lawful guardian confirms that they have read and understood this Privacy Notice, and hereby give verifiable consent for the Vidya Scholarship Portal to collect and process their and their child's personal data for the purposes stated above.
